prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A 73-year-old grandfather in a grey cardigan sits in his favourite armchair with an open hardback book, briefly looking up with a gentle half-smile. No book writing is legible. A reading lamp and folded blanket suggest an ordinary home. Use an eye-level medium portrait and soft late-afternoon window light. Output a vertical 4:5 composition for a website cover. Keep the lower 20 percent visually quiet for an optional website caption; place no faces, hands, or key gestures there. Preserve generous space above and beside the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearance: thinning closely cropped silver hair, a bald crown, thin rectangular reading glasses, blue-grey eyes, a gentle round face and a stocky build. His hands and book must be comfortably above the quiet bottom margin.
Composition priority: exact 4:5 aspect ratio, one complete standalone photograph with comfortable safe margins.
review: Reviewed full vertical image: balding silver-haired grandfather in rectangular glasses and grey cardigan holds an open blank-looking book. Both visible hands grip the book plausibly, without extra limbs; gentle face and natural age texture. Hands and book remain above a quiet lap area. Vertical 1122x1402.
